description: A user identity set on the global scope is attached to a subsequently captured event, exposing the email, id, ip address and username fields.

cases.expected_output:
captured_events=1
event[0].exception[0].type=RuntimeException
event[0].exception[0].value=test
event[0].user.email=test@example.com
event[0].user.id=123
event[0].user.ipAddress=127.0.0.1
event[0].user.username=testuser
